evals.name: stacking-avoids-index-conflict
evals.given: Three batches each add pages and regenerate a shared auto-generated index.
evals.when: Each branch is cut off the prior batch's tip and the index is regenerated rather than hand-edited.
evals.then: Each PR shows a clean superset index diff with no merge conflict on the shared file.

evals.name: guards-merge-cascade-strand
evals.given: A top stacked PR's base is an intermediate branch that has already been merged and deleted.
evals.when: After merging, the skill verifies origin/main's tree contains the merged pages.
evals.then: It detects the pages are missing from main (stranded), re-targets the PR to main, and re-merges so content reaches main.

evals.name: rejects-hand-edited-index
evals.given: A batch hand-edits the index table instead of regenerating it.
evals.when: The verification re-runs the index generator.
evals.then: The generator output diffs from the committed index, flagging the hand edit as the conflict source to revert.

evals.name: merge-order-bottom-up
evals.given: A reviewer is about to merge the newest PR in a 3-PR stack first.
evals.then: The oldest open PR is merged first; higher PRs wait until the one beneath them lands, with bases re-targeted as they move.
